alderney.title: Flag of Alderney

colors.note: Field within the cross bearing the coat of arms
Lion in the coat of arms

desc:
- A white field with a red St George's Cross bearing the coat of arms of Alderney at its centre
- The arms feature a golden lion on a green field. Adopted in 1993
- **Construction:** a white field bearing a red St George's Cross of standard proportions (one-fifth of the flag's width)
- The coat of arms is placed at the intersection of the cross
trivia:
- Alderney is one of the Channel Islands with its own distinct flag and governance
- The island has a population of around 2,000 people
- Alderney maintains its own culture and traditions distinct from mainland Britain
